explanation: Nonzero only at D1 after an unrewarded trial (always 0 at GO and D2, and at D1 after a rewarded trial); it builds with the run of consecutive losses: about 0-3 after the first loss, about 5-8 after the second or third. It peaks at 9-10 on the D1 just before the agent switches to or stays on a2 after repeated losses, and it is often 0 again on the D1 after the first loss that follows such an a2 switch.
